# Phases 0–1: design notes

## Phase 0: Unity Catalog foundation
* All DDL is idempotent (`IF NOT EXISTS`) and generated by `dfp.uc`, which can be unit-tested without Spark.
* Catalog per environment (`demand_planning`, `demand_planning_test`, `demand_planning_prod`). Free Edition has a
  single workspace and metastore, so environments are separated by catalog. dev/test can fall back to the
  `workspace` catalog if `CREATE CATALOG` is denied. prod never falls back.
* Volumes: `raw.source_files` (staging + landing + ground truth), `raw.checkpoints`, `ml.model_artifacts`, `audit.config`.
* Each run snapshots the YAML config into `audit.config/<timestamp>/` and writes a row to `audit.pipeline_run_log`.

## Phase 1: synthetic data model
Weekly mean demand per SKU × region:

```
mean = base × market × trend × season × exp(β·(T − T̄)) × festival × price_effect × promo × lifecycle × spike × exp(AR(1) noise)
price_effect = (regular/regular₀)^ε × (regular/competitor)^(0.6ε)
promo        = 1 + uplift₁₀·discount/10 + 0.25·display   (× post-promo dip in the following week)
```

Store level: `× store size × channel affinity(category) × e-commerce growth × ranged flag`. Units are drawn from a
negative binomial distribution with a pattern-specific dispersion. Intermittent SKUs add Bernoulli occurrence (p = 0.3).

Orders = 0.7 × POS(t) + 0.3 × POS(t+1) (forward buying) × lognormal noise. India General Trade orders fortnightly.
The DC inventory uses periodic review and order-up-to replenishment, with supplier lead time, MOQ and reliability.
It sets confirmed quantities, and therefore stockouts. Billing lines are generated from confirmed quantities.

### Why orders are the demand target
Shipments are capped by inventory, so they understate demand during stockouts. Ordered quantity is the
unconstrained signal. POS is used as a leading-indicator feature.

### Leakage controls set up here
* Future promotions carry `promotion_status` (`Approved` up to 52 weeks ahead, `Draft` after that) and `approved_date`.
* Future prices are only `Planned` list-price changes. Competitor prices are unknown in the future (null).
* Weather has actuals only up to the history end, plus one 14-day forecast issued on the last history day.
* Ground-truth columns (pattern labels, internal indices) never appear in raw files. A unit test enforces this.
